authorization.scope: six private internal calibration renders before Batch 1

sharedLock.camera: fixed 20-degree elevated three-quarter view with an 85 mm product-photography perspective
sharedLock.scale: primary subject occupies approximately 68 percent of canvas height with generous even padding
sharedLock.crop: centered full-object crop; no clipped edges
sharedLock.background: seamless deep-taupe to near-black studio cyclorama with no room context
sharedLock.lighting: broad warm key from upper left, restrained cool fill from right, soft controlled shadow down-right, subtle purple-to-teal edge reflection only
sharedLock.labelTreatment: blank matte-ivory label plane with no words, symbols, dosage, claims, or branding when a label surface is present
sharedLock.palette: near-black, deep taupe, warm graphite, restrained brushed metal, ivory highlights, subtle purple-to-teal accent

jobs.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: private internal Xenios product-card art-direction calibration
Primary request: Create one premium studio study of a generic unbranded crimp-vial form. This is a visual-system calibration, not an exact product depiction.
Scene/backdrop: seamless deep-taupe to near-black studio cyclorama; low matte warm-graphite plinth; no room context.
Subject: one compact opaque warm-graphite glass vial with a restrained brushed-dark-metal crimp cap and one blank matte-ivory label band. Contents must be completely invisible: no powder, cake, liquid, fill line, color, particles, or formulation cue.
Style/medium: photorealistic premium controlled product photography.
Composition/framing: square 1:1; fixed 20-degree elevated three-quarter view; 85 mm product-photography perspective; centered full object; subject about 68 percent of canvas height; generous even padding; no clipped edges.
Lighting/mood: broad warm key from upper left; restrained cool fill from right; soft controlled shadow down-right; subtle purple-to-teal reflection only along one metallic edge.
Color palette: near-black, deep taupe, warm graphite, restrained brushed metal, ivory highlight, subtle purple-to-teal accent.
Text: none. The label is completely blank.
Constraints: no claim about contents, manufacturer, pharmacy, sterility, prescription status, certification, or exact package identity. No other objects or props.
Avoid: leaves, plants, herbs, botanical or spa cues, wellness props, liquid splashes, clinic rooms, laboratory rooms, people, hands, syringes, needles, medical crosses, logos, brand names, legible text, certification marks, watermarks.
